dct_title_s: Cumberland County farmland map - East half
dct_description_sm: Eastern half of a map commissioned by the U. S. Department of Agriculture Soil Conservation Service showing all areas of important farmland in Cumberland County. Water and urban areas are also shown. This half includes an explanation of the soil survey process used to determine the different topographic features.
